title: Parallel transfer item: take effect
instructions: Choose the option that expresses the intended meaning, forms a natural word partnership and fits the situation.

parts.prompt: The revised safety rules will ___ effect at the start of term.

choice_rationales.A: Take effect is the natural neutral-formal expression meaning begin to operate.
choice_rationales.B: Make effect is not the expression used when a rule begins to operate.
choice_rationales.C: Do effect is not a natural partnership in this frame.
choice_rationales.D: Hold effect is not the fixed expression for a rule becoming active.

parts.hint: Which complete expression means ‘begin to operate’ in a notice or policy?
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Take effect’ is the established neutral-formal partnership for a rule beginning to operate.
